subject: Can I get results of estimation using MPI protocol in mirtCluster() function?

messages.author: 6a75f6f91a59c568
messages.subject: Can I get results of estimation using MPI protocol in mirtCluster() function?
parts:
Hello, Phil.

Can I get results of estimation using MPI protocol in mirtCluster() function?
I need to MIRT estimation with parallel computing using over 2 workstations like http://top500.org/system/177987, but I can't find a solution.

Best regards,
Seongho Bae.

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Can I get results of estimation using MPI protocol in mirtCluster() function?
parts:
I don't think so, it would require a huge change in the code base to support something like that (preferably all at the C level). I find MPI nice when one has to run simulations, but within individual analyses I just wouldn't want to deal with that complexity. mirtCluster() is only used for embarrassingly parallel jobs that are worth running in parallel. Cheers.

Phil
